description: Full recipe scaled to any number of servings, in US or metric units. Every step already contains the amounts it uses, so you can read steps aloud without referring back to the ingredient list. Works signed out (public recipes, substitute and units_for included, no preferences). A step's tip is a short pointer to pass on with the step. Mention the chef's note (chef_note) only if the cook asks about the recipe's background. your_versions lists the cook's own versions of this recipe, so you can say "you have your own version of this" and offer it. On a recipe the cook owns, revision counts their edits and revisions lists the last ten (undo one with update_recipe({ restore_revision })). When the cook asks for an amount in another unit ("how many tablespoons of butter is that?"), pass units_for rather than converting yourself: the list and every step follow. When the cook wants a change, pass substitute to get sound swaps for one ingredient or for a whole diet ("dairy-free"), already filtered by the cook's allergies and diet; then show the cook the changed ingredients and steps and, once they say yes, save with fork_recipe (or update_recipe on their own recipe).

servings.description: Scale to this many servings (defaults to the cook's household size, then the recipe's own)

substitute.description: Ask for substitutions: for one ingredient, for a diet, or both

for.description: What the swap is for: a diet (vegetarian, vegan, pescatarian, gluten-free, dairy-free, low-sodium, halal, kosher), an allergen-free tag (egg-free, nut-free, peanut-free, sesame-free, shellfish-free, soy-free) or a context (baking, sauce, frying, dressing). Alone, it covers every ingredient that breaks that diet.

units.description: US cups/oz/°F or metric grams/ml/°C. Defaults to the cook's setting.

units_for.description: The cook's own unit for particular ingredients, by ingredient key or name: { "butter": "tbsp", "flour": "g" }. Units: tsp, tbsp, cup, fl oz, ml, oz, lb, g. When the cook asks for an amount in another unit, pass this rather than converting yourself; the ingredient list and every step follow. Ones that can't convert come back in ignored_units

name: get_recipe
title: Get a recipe
